name: processor_D
description: Chemistry-optimized 12-qubit architecture with a fully-connected 4-qubit active orbital core (K4) and an 8-qubit outer ring for syndrome detection and readout isolation.
bottleneck_addressed: Eliminates routing SWAP overhead and compiler latency for up to 4-orbital molecular chemistry Hamiltonians while providing ancilla connectivity for parity syndrome checks.
source: Team custom design satisfying Phase 1 Section 11.1 guidelines (<= 12 qubits, explicit coupling graph, same nominal gate-error assumptions).
